P001.primary_diagnosis: Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus with Acute Hyperglycemia

required_follow_ups.instructions: Follow up with Dr. Chen for insulin and oral hypoglycemic adjustment

P002.primary_diagnosis: Acute Coronary Syndrome / Non-ST Elevation Myocardial Infarction (NSTEMI)
care_goals: Stent thrombosis prevention via dual antiplatelet therapy
Strict avoidance of NSAIDs and Aspirin due to severe allergic history

required_follow_ups.instructions: Outpatient clinic visit with Dr. Marcus Vance with repeat ECG
Initiate Phase II monitored exercise program

P002.dietary_restrictions: Heart-healthy Mediterranean diet, low saturated fat, sodium < 1500mg/day
P002.activity_orders: No heavy lifting (>10 lbs) for 2 weeks

required_follow_ups.instructions: Repeat chest X-ray and clinical examination with Dr. Taylor

P003.activity_orders: Incentive spirometry every 2 hours while awake

P004.primary_diagnosis: Hypertensive Crisis with Stage 3 Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD)
care_goals: Prevent renal function decline; monitor creatinine and electrolytes

required_follow_ups.instructions: Follow up with Dr. Vikram Sethi with repeat Serum Creatinine and Potassium

P004.dietary_restrictions: Low sodium (< 1500 mg/day), renal diet (moderate protein, limit potassium-rich foods)
P004.activity_orders: Light ambulatory walking; avoid strenuous isometric exertion
